item.description:
Hunters Agency + Co is pleased to offer to the market a prime opportunity to acquire an exceptional site within a peaceful location direct on the spectacular Parramatta River and with its key convenient and central location in the heart of Parramatta city !

This prime riverside location is perfect and stylishly ideal for the creation of this sophisticated development opportunity!
Direct access to waterfront parkland and cycleways make it a wonderful lifestyle address, with the benefits of Western Sydney University Parramatta campus nearby and being spoil with an abundance of dining and shopping options to the hearts content!

Investment Highlights:

-Prominent 5918.5 m2 Site footprint
-R4 High Density Zoning
-Water Front Location
-Ample permitted uses to increase profits Generous Height and FSR
-Once built water views and city views await 
-Centrally located to Universities, Parramatta CBD, Arterial roads, Schools, Shopping centres.

This unique offering will be sold either on one line or two as below

- On one line four properties being 85, 87, 89 & 91 Thomas st 
  Total land size 5918.5 sqm with 80.48 meter frontage
- On two lines two properties to form one site
  85 & 87 Thomas st total land size 2801.5 sqm with 40.24 m frontage
  89 & 91 Thomas st total land size 3117 sqm with 40.24 m frontage
 
Expressions of Interest close Monday 19 December 2022.
Please contact the exclusively appointed Hunters team for more information.
